Calls.description: Voice and video calls. Turning off calls turns off every calls_* flag.

calls.description: Off: hides every call button, blocks outgoing calls and declines incoming calls. A call already in progress is not ended.

calls_video.description: Off: hides the video-call buttons, the in-call camera toggle and the picture-in-picture camera action.

calls_flip_camera.description: Off: hides the flip-camera button during a call.

calls_speaker.description: Off: hides the speaker button during a call and in picture-in-picture.

calls_pip.description: Off: a call no longer goes into picture-in-picture when you leave the app.

calls_floating_bubble.description: Off: a minimized call stays in the top bar instead of the floating bubble or video tile.

Voice and video messages.description: Recording voice messages and video notes.

voice_messages.description: Off: hold-to-record voice messages are unavailable. With video_notes also off, the mic button is hidden.

video_notes.description: Off: the composer can't switch to video-note mode.

recording_lock.description: Off: removes slide-up-to-lock while recording voice messages and video notes.

Clip playback.description: Playing voice messages and video notes. Turning off clip_playback turns off the other three.

clip_playback.description: Off: voice messages and video notes can't be played.

clip_seek.description: Off: no seeking on the voice-message waveform or the video-note ring.

clip_mini_player.description: Off: hides the mini player that keeps a clip playing outside its chat. Turns off clip_playback_speed.

clip_playback_speed.description: Off: hides the playback-speed button in the mini player.

media_sending.description: Off: hides the attach button, so no photos or videos can be sent. Turns off media_camera and media_picker_filters.

media_camera.description: Off: removes the camera cell from the media picker and skips the camera permission request.

media_picker_filters.description: Off: hides the All / Photos / Videos chips in the media picker.

media_viewer.description: Off: tapping a photo or video no longer opens the fullscreen viewer.

media_download.description: Off: hides the download button on photos and videos.

media_cancel_transfer.description: Off: hides cancel on uploads and downloads in progress.

message_menu.description: Off: long-press no longer opens the message menu. Turns off copy and both deletes.

message_copy.description: Off: hides Copy in the message menu.

message_delete_for_me.description: Off: hides Delete for me in the message menu.

message_delete_for_everyone.description: Off: hides Delete for everyone in the message menu.

message_reply.description: Off: hides Reply in the message menu. Turns off message_swipe_reply and message_reply_jump.

message_swipe_reply.description: Off: swiping a message no longer starts a reply.

message_reply_jump.description: Off: tapping a quoted message no longer jumps to the original.

chat_swipe_navigation.description: Off: no swipe back and no swipe to the partner's profile on the chat screen.

chat_list_swipe_actions.description: Off: chat rows no longer swipe to reveal actions. Turns off the four row-action flags below.

chat_list_mark_read.description: Off: hides Mark as read in the row swipe actions.

chat_list_delete.description: Off: hides Delete in the row swipe actions.

chat_list_delete_for_everyone.description: Off: hides Delete for everyone in the row swipe actions.

chat_list_edit.description: Off: hides Edit in the row swipe actions.

chat_list_pull_refresh.description: Off: turns off pull to refresh on the chat list.

search.description: Off: hides the search pill and the search overlay. Turns off search_recent.

search_recent.description: Off: hides the recently searched and recently opened rows.

profile_avatar_upload.description: Off: you can't add an avatar photo. Turns off profile_avatar_camera.

profile_avatar_camera.description: Off: hides Take a photo when adding an avatar.

profile_edit.description: Off: hides the Edit profile button.

profile_change_phone.description: Off: hides Change phone number on the edit-profile screen.

profile_edit_change_photo.description: Change photo on the edit-profile and contact screens. Not built yet: off in release builds unless you publish true.

accounts_switch.description: Switch account in Settings and Edit profile. Not built yet: off in release builds unless you publish true.

Partner profile.description: The profile screen of the person you chat with.

partner_profile_edit_contact.description: Off: hides the Edit button that renames or deletes the contact.

partner_profile_mute.description: Mute button. Not built yet: off in release builds unless you publish true.

partner_profile_block.description: Block button. Not built yet: off in release builds unless you publish true.

partner_profile_shared_media.description: Shared media tabs. Not built yet: off in release builds unless you publish true.

Appearance.description: Rows on the Appearance settings screen.

appearance_wallpapers.description: Off: hides the wallpaper section. Turns off custom wallpapers and the intensity slider.

appearance_custom_wallpaper.description: Off: hides the Add tile and saved wallpapers (with rename and delete).

appearance_wallpaper_intensity.description: Off: hides the wallpaper intensity slider.

appearance_dark_theme.description: Off: hides the Dark theme toggle.

appearance_bar_position.description: Off: hides the navigation bar position setting.

appearance_text_size.description: Off: hides the Text size setting.

Settings.description: Settings rows that are not finished. All are off in release builds unless you publish true.

settings_privacy_controls.description: Privacy toggles that only change local settings. Delete account always stays visible.

settings_security.description: The Security row. Its items do nothing until the recovery-code work is merged.

settings_notification_controls.description: The Notifications and Sounds row (local settings only).

settings_language.description: The Language row (no language is applied yet).

notification_inline_reply.description: Off: hides Reply on message notifications.

notification_mark_read.description: Off: hides Mark as read on message notifications.

notification_shortcuts.description: Off: no conversation shortcuts. Turns off notification_bubbles.

notification_bubbles.description: Off: hides Open in window and the chat bubble on notifications.
